triage#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZKP5YM48rWMWTS7wE

Triage: lands in `area:ux` · `domain:ui` · `priority:p2` · Bug · `pm:queue` · size S. The filing seat's area and grade stand. Type set to Bug.
Rationale: on a phone, the end padding sits on the route slot instead of inside the scrolled content, so the last ~33 px of a long page stays under the bottom bar (measured on the showcase stack). This is a UX problem that is not hit by every user every time on a core feature. Under North Star Priority rule 2 that is p2, because UX has no p3. The fix is in the `ConsoleLayout` phone inset, as the card proposes.
